common.footerNote: AImaginator — AI image generation and editing.

landing.headline: Turn words into images.
landing.subheadline: AImaginator is an AI image generator that creates and edits images from natural language prompts. Describe what you want, generate it in seconds, and refine the result iteratively.
landing.promptPlaceholder: Describe the image you want to create...

steps.title: Describe
steps.description: Write a natural-language prompt describing the image you want. The more specific the details, the better the result.
steps.imageAlt: Example of an AI image of minimalist white architecture.

steps.title: Generate
steps.description: The AI model processes your prompt and produces a first image in real time, with progress shown step by step.
steps.imageAlt: Example of an AI image of a mountain landscape with a lake.

steps.title: Refine
steps.description: Adjust the prompt or upload an image to edit details iteratively until the result matches your intent.
steps.imageAlt: Example of an AI image of sunlight through a forest.

faq.question: What is AImaginator?
faq.answer: AImaginator is a web app and API that generates and edits images with AI from natural-language prompts. You describe the image and the model produces it in real time.

faq.question: Do I need to create an account?
faq.answer: Yes. Sign in with your Google account to generate images. The public gallery is available without logging in.

faq.question: Can I edit existing images?
faq.answer: Yes. In the studio you can upload an image and describe the edits you want, iterating on the result.

faq.question: How does real-time progress work?
faq.answer: Generation status streams from the API over server-sent events (SSE), showing percent progress until the image is ready or an error is returned.

studio.title: Studio
studio.loginRequired: Log in with Google to access the generation studio.
studio.uploadHint: PNG or JPEG — optional, sent together with the prompt to edit it.

status.idle: Idle. Describe an image to start.
status.queued: Queued. Waiting for an available worker.
status.done: Done. The image was generated successfully.
